display.purpose: Page titles and database names only.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, kbd hints, language tags.

shadows.name: button-volumetric
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #FDFCF8 55%, transparent), 0 2px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #C65D3B 62%, #2E2A26), 0 12px 24px -10px color-mix(in oklab, #C65D3B 60%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons only — the pencil pressed into paper.

shadows.name: button-ghost-lip
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #FDFCF8 70%, transparent), 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, #2E2A26 14%, transparent), 0 6px 14px -10px color-mix(in oklab, #2E2A26 35%, transparent)

shadows.name: float-lift
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, #2E2A26 9%, transparent), 0 10px 26px -14px color-mix(in oklab, #2E2A26 28%, transparent)

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All state transitions; exponential ease-out from visible default.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The terracotta pencil — one primary action per region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #a84e2e; color: #FDFCF8; font: 600 13px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; padding: 9px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(253,252,248,.55), 0 2px 0 #7c3a1e, 0 12px 24px -10px rgba(168,78,46,.6); transition: background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8f4122; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(253,252,248,.45), 0 1px 0 #7c3a1e, 0 6px 14px -8px rgba(168,78,46,.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a84e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action — filters, restore, utilities.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #FDFCF8; color: #4a463f; border: 1px solid #d8d4c8; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; font: 600 12px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(253,252,248,.7), 0 1px 0 rgba(46,42,38,.14), 0 6px 14px -10px rgba(46,42,38,.35); transition: all .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #2E2A26; border-color: #a39d90; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C65D3B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field (sidebar)
components.description: The quiet entry to everything — Ctrl/Cmd+K hint attached.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #FDFCF8; border: 1px solid #ece9dd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; color: #76705f; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-search:hover { border-color: #d8d4c8; } .ds-search kbd { font: 400 10.5px ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; background: #f7f5ef; border: 1px solid #ece9dd; border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 5px; color: #5d584e; }

components.name: Select Pill (database)
components.description: Status/priority pills; tone dot encodes the value hue job.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 600 11.5px/1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px; letter-spacing: .01em; } .ds-pill i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; display: block; } .ds-pill-terra { background: #f6e2d9; color: #a94f31; } .ds-pill-terra i { background: #C65D3B; } .ds-pill-sage { background: #eef0e4; color: #64744e; } .ds-pill-sage i { background: #7a8a63; } .ds-pill-ink { background: #f0ece1; color: #46413a; } .ds-pill-ink i { background: #76705f; }

components.name: Sidebar Tree Row (active)
components.description: Notebook index row; active = paper fill + authored terracotta ink-stroke tab at the leading edge.
components.css: .ds-treerow { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: none; padding: 3px 6px 3px 2px; border-radius: 6px; color: #5d584e; font: 400 13.5px/1.9 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-treerow:hover { background: #f0ede3; color: #2E2A26; } .ds-treerow.is-active { background: #FDFCF8; color: #2E2A26; font-weight: 600; } .ds-treerow-tab { position: absolute; left: -5px; top: 50%; width: 7px; height: 17px; transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-3deg); color: #C65D3B; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Slash Menu
components.css: .ds-slash { width: 284px; background: #FDFCF8; border: 1px solid #d8d4c8; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(46,42,38,.09), 0 10px 26px -14px rgba(46,42,38,.28); overflow: hidden; animation: ds-pop .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-slash-head { font: 700 10px/1 'Hanken Grotesk'; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #76705f; padding: 8px 12px 4px; margin: 0; } .ds-slash-item { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; width: 100%; border: none; background: none; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slash-item:hover { background: #faf0eb; } @keyframes ds-pop { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px) scale(.97); } }

narrative.overview: Takenotes is a well-kept paper desk that happens to be software: warm paper ground, ink for writing, terracotta for action, sage for state. Chrome recedes; the notes lead. Everything is ink, paper, and hairlines — the only cast shadows belong to buttons.
keyCharacteristics: Four hues only: warm paper, soft ink, terracotta, sage — every derivative via color-mix
Serif display (Newsreader) for titles; Hanken Grotesk for working UI
Flat at rest; volumetric shadow on pill buttons only; floating menus carry one tight shadow
Hairline ink-tinted rules as the only dividers

rules.name: The Four-Pencil Rule
rules.body: Only paper, ink, terracotta, sage and their mixtures. Red is terra-deep, green is sage-deep. A fifth hue means the build is wrong.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Terracotta holds ≤10% of any screen. Its power is scarcity.

rules.name: The Flat-Desk Rule
rules.body: If a surface wants a shadow, it must be a button or a transient menu. Everything else is ink, paper, and hairlines.

rules.name: The Ink Measure Rule
rules.body: Body text never exceeds 75ch; the canvas caps at 780px.

dos: Do use only the four hues and their color-mix derivatives
Do reserve terracotta for actions and the active marker
Do keep shadows on buttons and floating menus only
Do set page titles in Newsreader 600; body copy in Hanken Grotesk 400/15
Do keep hairline ink-tinted rules as the only dividers
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glassmorphism, or colored glows
Don't use a colored border thicker than a 2px hairline on cards, rows, callouts, or alerts
Don't ship emoji or unicode glyphs as the icon system
Don't add a fifth hue for semantics — deepen terra or sage
Don't load fonts from a CDN; fonts are self-hosted
Don't box the editor canvas; the writing surface is the ground itself
